name: Location Keep-Alive & Service Sentinel
description: Multi-process background architecture isolating location sampling in dedicated :service process via EventController and LocationWorker to protect background tracking from UI main process crashes, subject to Android OS lifecycle and OEM power constraints.
behavior_summary: Operates ForegroundService with location foregroundServiceType, listens to heartbeats, and runs WorkManager watchdog to guarantee continuous background survival.

reusability_assessment.notes: Architectural model for Family OS continuous location tracking sentinel (S1-07).

name: Fused Location Sampling Controller
description: Adaptive GPS and network location sampling controller wrapping Google Play Services FusedLocationProviderClient with motion-aware duty cycling.
behavior_summary: Dispatches FUSED_LOCATION_UPDATE broadcasts, dynamically scales sampling frequency from stationary dwell (0 Hz) to active driving (0.5 Hz).

reusability_assessment.notes: Core design pattern for Family OS battery-efficient GPS polling (S1-07).

name: Kalman Filter & Motion State Machine
description: Algorithmic Kalman filter and discrete motion state machine smoothing raw noisy GPS points and computing true heading and velocity.
behavior_summary: Applies 1D/2D Kalman variance tracking, filters stationary jitter, and detects movement transitions between STATIONARY, WALKING, and IN_VEHICLE.

reusability_assessment.notes: Clean-room mathematical algorithm directly suitable for Family OS S1-07 engine.

name: Device Health & Power Management Sentinel
description: Subsystem monitoring battery state, power-saving restrictions, Doze mode status, and location accuracy health across circle devices.
behavior_summary: Catches power saver notifications, prompts users for battery optimization exemptions, and synchronizes device battery percentages to circles.

reusability_assessment.notes: Essential for Family OS battery telemetry and device health card (S1-07).

name: Circles & Places Geofencing Boundary Engine
description: Multi-circle geographical place boundary management system tracking circular and polygonal geofence regions.
behavior_summary: Maintains inner, outer, local, and zone geofences, intercepting hardware geofence transitions to notify circles upon entry/exit.

reusability_assessment.notes: Core model for Family OS Places and Geofence alerts (S2-04).

name: Geofence Boundary Hysteresis & Anti-Flapping Filter
description: Spatial and temporal hysteresis filter preventing rapid oscillation and duplicate notifications when a device lingers on place boundaries.
behavior_summary: Enforces 15-meter hysteresis deadband and 60-second continuous dwell requirement before confirming entry or exit state changes.

reusability_assessment.notes: Solves false-positive notifications in Family OS Places system (S2-04).

name: High-Frequency Sensor Telemetry Framework
description: Unified hardware sensor acquisition framework collecting accelerometer, gyroscope, barometer, and rotation readings at up to 100Hz.
behavior_summary: Buffers multi-axis IMU readings in native memory, timestamping motion events for collision physics and driving pattern evaluation.

reusability_assessment.notes: Foundational sensor collection architecture for Family OS safety modules.

name: Crash Detection & Impact Physics Engine
description: Multi-axis impact detection engine computing peak G-force, impulse Delta-V, and phone-drop rejection filters with emergency siren countdown.
behavior_summary: Analyzes sudden deceleration (>4G), validates trajectory continuity, triggers 10-second audible alert, and initiates automatic dispatch if uncancelled.

reusability_assessment.notes: Derivative clean-room model for Family OS vehicular safety features (S1-07).

name: Driving Behavior & Safety Scoring Telemetry
description: Automatic trip detection, incident tracking (hard braking, rapid acceleration, phone usage), and composite driver safety score calculation.
behavior_summary: Monitors speed differentials (>13 km/h/s deceleration, >11 km/h/s acceleration), logs phone distraction periods, and generates weekly 0-100 score.

reusability_assessment.notes: Model for Family OS teen driving safety and weekly report cards.

name: Native Realm JNI Shared Library Component
description: Presence of librealm-jni.so binary across 5 CPU architectures with bundled io.realm classes; retained as an architectural native library reference without asserting first-party telemetry persistence.
behavior_summary: Leverages C++ mmap() zero-copy access to ingest 100Hz sensor bursts into thread-confined ring buffers, completely eliminating UI stutter.

reusability_assessment.notes: Architectural benchmark demonstrating why zero-copy ring buffering is required for 100Hz telemetry.

name: Emergency SOS & Safety Dispatch Protocol
description: Silent and audible emergency distress dispatch subsystem featuring PIN-protected cancellation, SMS escalation, and external dispatch dispatching.
behavior_summary: Dispatches PSOSAlertRequest with START_ALERT payload, broadcasts real-time emergency coordinates, and requires authenticated PIN to abort.

reusability_assessment.notes: Core model for Family OS emergency SOS dispatching and child panic protocol (S1-07).

name: BLE Beacon & Tile Tracking Ingestion Subsystem
description: Bluetooth Low Energy advertisement scanner and community ingestion engine for capturing broadcast packets from nearby Tile hardware tags via standard BLE manufacturer advertising, without employing peer-to-peer BLE Mesh networking.
behavior_summary: Passively scans BLE advertisement packets in background, batches sighting beacons, and securely uploads to /api/v1/clients/batch_location_updates.

reusability_assessment.notes: Model for Family OS community lost-item and child tag tracking.

name: Realtime Location Streaming & PubNub Dispatcher
description: Low-latency WebSocket streaming pipeline delivering sub-250ms delta coordinate packets across circle channels for smooth map marker animation.
behavior_summary: Subscribes to 'circle_{circleId}_locations' WebSockets, unmarshals compact short-key JSON payloads, and feeds marker interpolation renderers.

reusability_assessment.notes: Direct architectural design for Family OS live map synchronization.

name: REST Ingestion & Telemetry Upload Gateway
description: Retrofit REST client layer cataloging 182 method declarations (155 unique endpoints) across 19 interface files for coordinate batch ingestion, driving log upload, emergency dispatch, and circle administration.
behavior_summary: Handles HTTP POST /v1/ingest, PUT locations, and secure OAuth2 bearer token authentication across api.life360.com and driverbehavior.life360.com.

reusability_assessment.notes: Comprehensive blueprint for Family OS cloud telemetry ingestion schema.

name: Local Room / SQLite Relational Schema
description: Relational database schema managing 10 tables for circle members, place geofences, driving trip segments, and offline telemetry buffering.
behavior_summary: Persists structured entity definitions including compound primary key (member_id, circle_id), place coordinates, and TripBlock telemetry records.

reusability_assessment.notes: Data model basis for Family OS S1-02 Circles and S1-07 Location storage.

name: Android Manifest Platform & Process Architecture
description: Decompiled application manifest configuring SDK parameters, 31 system permissions, 15 activities, 29 services, 49 receivers, and 16 providers.
behavior_summary: Declares com.life360.android.safetymapd package, configures multi-process execution (:service), and requests hardware sensor and background location permissions.

reusability_assessment.notes: Structural reference for Android manifest configuration in Family OS.
